name: Basic auditory processing
description: Early cortical analysis of sound (frequency, timing, level) that occurs for nearly any audible sound.

name: Coding of sound level / loudness
description: Representation of how loud a sound is; related to, but not identical with, physical intensity.

name: Detecting acoustic onsets
description: Marking moments where sound starts or rises sharply, which can signal the start of phrases, sentences or events.

name: Involuntary orienting to salient change
description: Attention being drawn to an unexpected or sudden change in the sensory environment.

name: Voice perception
description: Processing sounds recognised as human vocalisations (speech and non-speech such as laughs or cries).

name: Sentence-level language comprehension
description: Combining words into meaningful phrases and sentences when a listener understands the language.

name: Semantic processing (word and concept meaning)
description: Retrieving and combining knowledge about what words and concepts mean.

name: Integrating a narrative over time
description: Building a model of a story or situation across sentences, paragraphs and events.

name: Thinking about others' mental states (theory of mind)
description: Representing what characters or speakers believe, want, know or feel.

name: Music-selective auditory processing
description: Auditory cortical responses that are stronger for music than for other sounds, beyond simple acoustic features.

name: Song perception
description: Processing of sung music as distinct from speech or instrumental music.

name: Beat and rhythm perception
description: Perceiving a regular pulse and rhythmic timing, which links auditory and motor timing systems.

name: Music-evoked pleasure and emotion (listener-dependent)
description: Pleasure, chills or strong emotion that some listeners experience with some music.

name: Musical structure processing in language regions (contested)
description: Whether processing musical structure (e.g., unexpected chords) recruits the same frontal regions as language.

name: Early and intermediate visual processing
description: Analysis of the visual image across the visual field in occipital cortex.

name: Early visual response to non-motion image change
description: Responses to changes in the image that are not explained by motion, such as illumination changes.

name: Visual motion processing
description: Perceiving movement of objects or of the whole scene (e.g., camera motion).

name: Face perception
description: Detecting and analysing faces.

name: Scene and place perception
description: Perceiving the spatial layout of places (rooms, streets, landscapes).

name: Event segmentation
description: Dividing continuous experience into meaningful events, with updating at event boundaries.

name: Humor comprehension (getting the joke)
description: Detecting and resolving an incongruity that makes something funny.

name: Humor appreciation (mirth)
description: The enjoyable feeling that can follow understanding a joke.

name: Suspense-related attentional engagement
description: Heightened, narrowed attention to plot-relevant information when an outcome is uncertain and matters.

name: Specific emotion categories (e.g., fear, sadness, joy)
description: Discrete emotions. Included so the app can explain why they are not mapped to specific regions.

name: Narrative surprise
description: An unexpected plot turn. Included so the app can explain why it is not mapped.
